title: canon-decisions/1
description: A list of `ExplicitDecision` entries. One entry of a `canon-decisions/1` document. It applies to `outcome` when the outcome requires a decision named `decision`, `case_revision` is the case snapshot's revision and every ground holds. An entry given twice, every key equal, is refused.

Identifier.description: A well-formed identifier is not empty, and without whitespace, control characters or Unicode format characters (general category Cf). The pattern checks only for whitespace; Canon also refuses control and Unicode format characters.

EvidenceDigest.description: The digest of a `canon-evidence/1` record's contents (story:evidence-digest-binds-approvals): `sha256:` followed by the 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits of the SHA-256 of the record's canonical form, the JSON Canonicalization Scheme (RFC 8785) of one object holding each field of the record as Canon reads it under its own key: `format`, `id`, `kind`, `subject` and `subject_revision` always, `result`, `observed_at`, `producer`, `child_case` and `item` when given, and `upstream_revisions`, an object of artifact to revision, when not empty; every value a string, as written. So neither the key order nor the whitespace of the file changes it, and two records have one digest exactly when a repeated delivery of a record counts once. `canon digest --evidence <file>` prints it. Canon refuses any other form, naming the entry.

ExplicitDecision.description: One entry of a `canon-decisions/1` document. It applies to `outcome` when the outcome requires a decision named `decision`, `case_revision` is the case snapshot's revision and every ground holds.

outcome.description: The outcome it was taken for.

case_revision.description: The case revision it was taken at.

ground_revisions.description: The artifact revisions the decision rested on, keyed by artifact, each key once (story:decision-grounds): a ground holds while its revision is the case snapshot's current revision of the artifact, compared for equality. Absent or empty, it rests on no artifact.

ground_evidence.description: The evidence records the decision rested on, each by id or by id and digest (`EvidenceGround`): a ground holds while a record with that id is applicable, the rule of `missing_evidence` (given, left by the revision-binding and freshness stages, and listed in no claim's `excluded_evidence`), so expiry and invalidation reach the decision through it, and, when it gives a digest, while that record has the digest. An id no record has does not hold and is not refused. Absent or empty, it rests on no record.

EvidenceGround.description: One evidence record a decision rested on, an entry of `ground_evidence` (story:evidence-digest-binds-approvals). Written as the record's id alone (`e1`), or as a map with the id and, optionally, the digest of the record's contents when the decision was taken (`{id: e1, digest: 'sha256:…'}`, the digest `canon digest --evidence <file>` prints). A map without a digest is the id alone. With a digest, the ground holds only while the record given under the id has that digest; with other contents under the id it fails as `content_changed`, whether or not the record is applicable. Refused as `malformed-input`, naming the entry: a map with another key or without `id`, and a digest not written `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

oneOf.description: The record's id alone: the ground holds while a record with the id is applicable, whatever the rest of its contents.
The record's id with, optionally, the digest of its contents.

CitedEvidence.description: An evidence ground written as a map: the record's id and, optionally, the digest of its contents.

digest.description: The digest of the record's contents when the decision was taken. Absent, the ground holds as the id alone does.
